sub.account: What Retail owes the ERP, from the shop's own ledger. An entry is never changed or deleted: a mistake is put right by a new entry.
sub.match: Every night the shop's books are checked against the ERP's, day by day, with zero tolerance. One paisa off is a difference.
sub.differences: What did not match, and how it is put right. A number is never edited: a mistake is undone by a reversing entry and a new one.
sub.closes: Days close by themselves at night. A month is closed with the owner's PIN once every day matched.

bk.v5: The books start when this store switches to ERP contract v6. Until then nothing is written here.
bk.noLink: This store has no ERP connection of its own yet. The books open with its first ERP pull.

hold.on: On hold: the ERP takes no new orders
hold.holdsOn: A hold starts on {date} if no payment comes
hold.noPay: No payment recorded by the ERP yet

chain.broken: The ledger was changed outside the shop at entry {seq}. Tell the developer at once.

bk.opening: Opening balance at the switch: {amount} from {date}

empty.entriesSub: The first entry comes when an order's parcel leaves (the ERP's bill).
empty.pipelineSub: Every billed piece is delivered, approved or declined.

pay.done: Saved. Nothing was sent to the ERP and no money moved.
pay.warn: This only writes down a payment you already made to the ERP. It sends no money and nothing to the ERP.
pay.readOnly: Only Accounts or the owner can record a payment to the ERP.
pay.matched: Matched with the ERP's payment of {date}
pay.shopOnly: The ERP has not recorded it yet
pay.erpOnly: Payments the ERP recorded that are not recorded here

err.NOT_FOUND: It is not there any more. Reload the page.
err.NOT_V6: The books start when this store switches to ERP contract v6.
err.NO_LINK: This store has no ERP connection of its own yet.
err.CONFLICT: This cannot be done to this record.
err.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this.
err.default: That did not work. Try again.
err.PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong PINs. Wait a while and try again.
err.PIN_NOT_SET: The owner has not set a PIN yet (Closes page).
err.WEAK_PIN: That PIN is too easy. Use digits, not one digit repeated or a straight run.
err.NOT_ADJUSTABLE: This difference is found again from the books; put the row that is wrong right.
err.NOT_MATCHED: Not every day matched: {fields}. Write a reason to close anyway.
err.FIXED_COSTS_MISSING: The month's fixed costs are not in. Write a reason to close anyway.
err.NOTHING_TO_CLOSE: There are no books in this period.
err.BUSY: A run of the books is going on. Try again in a few minutes.

class.MISSING_EVENT: The ERP has a row we do not
class.UNKNOWN_ROW: We have a row the ERP does not
class.TIE_BROKEN: The tie does not add up

match.chainBroken: A close was changed outside the shop. Tell the developer at once.
match.partly: Partly checked (the ERP does not give this yet): {checks}
match.runWarn: This reads the ERP and checks every day not closed yet. Nothing is changed in the ERP.
match.noneSub: The first close runs tonight after the close time.

diff.noneSub: Every check of every closed day matched.
diff.adjustSend: Reverse and add the right entry
diff.adjustWarn: This writes a reversing entry for our row and a new entry with the ERP's amount. Nothing is edited or deleted. It needs the owner's PIN.
diff.event: The ERP's matching row or event
diff.adjustDone: Put right. The day is checked again tonight (or press Check now).

how.TIE_BROKEN: Found again from the entries: put the row that is wrong right, and the tie follows.
how.STALE_SUMMARY: Send the summary or the fixed costs again (Hisabi).
how.UNMATCHED_PAYMENT: Record the payment, or reverse the wrong record, on the ERP account page.
how.HISTORY_CHANGED: A matched day's own money moved. Check it; it settles by itself when the day matches again, otherwise the month closes only with the owner's decision.
how.RETURNS: Wait for the ERP check, or find the piece.
how.WAITING_EVENT: The ERP's event for this row has not reached the shop yet. The pull brings it and the next match settles this; nothing is typed by hand.

diff.billedAtMissing: The shipment's answer had no bill date (never guessed). It is filled from the ERP's order; or "Put right" books the bill from the ERP's row, once.

close.pinNotSet: No PIN yet. Corrections and closes need it.
close.pinDone: The PIN is saved. It is never shown again.
close.pinWarn: Only the owner. Digits only; not one digit repeated, not 123456.
close.closeWarn: Closes only if every day matched and the fixed costs are in. Otherwise write a reason: the month is then closed with your decision, and it says so on every report.
close.overrideReason: Reason, only to close with differences
close.reopenWarn: A new version is written; the old close stays in the history.
close.yearWarn: Only once the year has ended and every month of it is closed.
close.lifetime: Since the switch: ours {ours}, the ERP {erp}
close.noneSub: The first month appears with the first day of the books.
